content.title: Memorial Bench Program
content.summary: Arvada's Memorial Bench Program allows community members to honor loved ones by purchasing a bench dedicated to them, complete with a personalized plaque. The program, which runs year-round, has a fee of $5,000 per bench and offers installation in approved locations throughout the city's parks and trails, subject to availability. Interested individuals can apply online through the city's recreation management system, Civic Rec.
content.body:
![Light blue metal bench with memorial plaque on backrest, set on concrete pad.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7015 "Light blue metal bench with memorial plaque on backrest, set on concrete pad.")

Arvada’s Memorial Bench Program offers community members and other donors a meaningful way to honor loved ones while enhancing the beauty and usability of our public spaces.

Through this program, individuals can purchase a bench to dedicate in memory of a family member, friend, or community figure. Each bench includes a personalized plaque recognizing the individual being commemorated.

Memorial benches create a lasting tribute that can be enjoyed by the Arvada community while supporting the City’s efforts to maintain and improve public amenities.

Benches are installed in approved locations throughout Arvada’s parks and open space trails. Please keep in mind that not all Arvada parks and trails have the capacity for a memorial bench due to irrigation, trees and other factors. You can pick your preferred location where you want the memorial bench installed as part of the application process.

To purchase a memorial bench, fill out the Memorial Bench Program application on the City’s online recreation management system, [Civic Rec](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=bG9jYXRpb24lNUI0OTQ2NyU1RD0xJnNlYXJjaD0mcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjE1NGNiZmNmYzMzZDBiN2U3OWZiNjkwNGY4YzM3YTk1PWVkYTdmYTdjOGQ1YTZjNzAyOWVmNjQxY2U3YTc5NDk1).

### [Submit Application](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=bG9jYXRpb24lNUI0OTQ2NyU1RD0xJnNlYXJjaD0mcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjE1NGNiZmNmYzMzZDBiN2U3OWZiNjkwNGY4YzM3YTk1PWVkYTdmYTdjOGQ1YTZjNzAyOWVmNjQxY2U3YTc5NDk1 "Memorial Bench Application")

## Program details

- The Memorial Bench Program runs year-round
- **Program Fee:** $5,000 flat rate fee per bench, which includes personalized plaque and concrete pad
- **Getting Started**: [Submit an application through Civic Rec](https://secure.rec1.com/CO/arvada-co/catalog/index?filter=bG9jYXRpb24lNUI0OTQ2NyU1RD0xJnNlYXJjaD0mcmVudGFsJTVCZnJvbSU1RD0mcmVudGFsJTVCdG8lNUQ9JjE1NGNiZmNmYzMzZDBiN2U3OWZiNjkwNGY4YzM3YTk1PWVkYTdmYTdjOGQ1YTZjNzAyOWVmNjQxY2U3YTc5NDk1)
- **Application Details**: You will select your preferred location (if available), provide the name of the individual you wish to commemorate, and specify the text for the engraved plaque
- **Location Considerations:** Please keep in mind that not all Arvada parks and trails have the capacity for new memorial benches based on factors such as location of irrigation and trees, proximity to existing park benches, and the location of hazards
- **Next Steps**: After the application is submitted, the City's Vibrant Community and Neighborhoods (VCN) Department will contact you to finalize details. Once finalized, you will receive an email from Civic Rec with a link to pay online.

## More information

For more information, [view the City's Memorial Bench Program Policy](https://arvada.form.transform.civicplus.com/62895) and view the FAQs.
